inspection.scene: Single orange hen in terracotta-and-cream striped singlet lifts wooden barbell with exactly one cooked round Fibriki on each end. Two wings and two bird legs; no human muscular arms, metal weights or extra characters.
inspection.food: Unbreaded whole and cut prepared meatballs printed on paper; actual tray contains pale raw-frozen balls with tiny green flecks, no browned tray contents.
inspection.claims: No new numeric claims, weight, preparation time, certifications or badges.
inspection.geometry: Complete shallow transparent ribbed PET tray and cream sleeve; no clipping. Silhouette slightly larger than v11 and should be normalized if selected.

limitations: First attempt showed excessive rice-like texture; second targeted correction made the cut face more uniform but a fine polygonal/granular texture remains. No distinct rice/vegetable ingredients are depicted; further food-image polish is recommended before production artwork.
Some stylized wing tips curl around the handle like cartoon grip fingers; no separate human arms.
